title: route sends bug tickets through frame-product and never through review-diff
desc:
wb route on a bug ticket returns the full route with frame (frame-product) as step 2 -- framing the product case of a bug fix. And no route, light or full, has a review step, though review-diff exists to self-review before a PR.

ACCEPTANCE:
- frame appears only for feature tickets, or when a frame.md already exists
- review (review-diff, wb review gates KEY) sits between verify and commit on every route, light included
- --json carries the same steps
- tests for bug, feature and light routes
